node.title: All-LineRay affine-core set-pair bound
node.statement: Let P be all distinct transverse sparse error pairs on one nonconstant syndrome line, let s be their affine error rank, and let w be their maximum weight. Zero-mask restriction is injective on the affine core; canonical full-rank zero minors form a nonuniform Bollobas set-pair system. Therefore sum_(gamma,e)1/C(s+wt(e),s)<=1 and |P|<=C(s+w,s)<=C(n,s). Applying the same theorem to any one-per-slope selector gives #slopes<=C(sigma+r,sigma), where sigma is the minimum selector rank and r=n-A. Exact arithmetic at all six XR candidates pays sigma<=3, while sigma=4 fails. Thus both XR predicates are paid whenever a rank-at-most-three selector exists; every selector in the residual has rank at least four.
